arguments.script: var setup=UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.GetSceneManagerSetup();var lines=new System.Collections.Generic.List<string>();int errors=0;try{foreach(var path in System.IO.Directory.GetFiles("Assets/Scenes","*.unity").Where(p=>!p.Contains("MainMenu")).OrderBy(p=>p)){var s=UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.OpenScene(path);int pairs=0,top=0,down=0;var usedTop=new System.Collections.Generic.HashSet<int>();var usedDown=new System.Collections.Generic.HashSet<int>();var roots=s.GetRootGameObjects();var groups=new System.Collections.Generic.List<System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<UnityEngine.Vector3Int,UnityEngine.Sprite>>();foreach(var m in roots.SelectMany(g=>g.GetComponentsInChildren<UnityEngine.Tilemaps.Tilemap>(true))){var a=new System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<UnityEngine.Vector3Int,UnityEngine.Sprite>();foreach(var c in m.cellBounds.allPositionsWithin)if(m.GetTile(c) is RockVariationTile)a[c]=m.GetSprite(c);var snap=string.Join(";",a.Select(p=>p.Key+":"+p.Value.name));m.RefreshAllTiles();if(snap!=string.Join(";",a.Select(p=>p.Key+":"+m.GetSprite(p.Key).name)))errors++;groups.Add(a);}var legacy=new System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<UnityEngine.Vector3Int,UnityEngine.Sprite>();foreach(var r in roots.SelectMany(g=>g.GetComponentsInChildren<UnityEngine.SpriteRenderer>(true)).Where(r=>r.sprite&&r.sprite.name.StartsWith("m")&&UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(r.sprite).StartsWith("Assets/Tiles/RockVariations/")&&!r.GetComponentInParent<UnityEngine.Rigidbody2D>())){var p=r.transform.position;legacy[new UnityEngine.Vector3Int(UnityEngine.Mathf.RoundToInt(p.x/.8f-.5f),UnityEngine.Mathf.RoundToInt((p.y+3.6f)/.8f-.5f),0)]=r.sprite;}groups.Add(legacy);foreach(var g in groups)foreach(var item in g){var match=System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Match(item.Value.name,@"m(\d+)-t(\d+)-d(\d+)");if(!match.Success){errors++;continue;}int mask=int.Parse(match.Groups[1].Value),t=int.Parse(match.Groups[2].Value),d=int.Parse(match.Groups[3].Value);if((mask&1)==0){top++;usedTop.Add(t);}if((mask&2)==0){down++;usedDown.Add(d);}foreach(var delta in new[]{UnityEngine.Vector3Int.right,UnityEngine.Vector3Int.up}){UnityEngine.Sprite other;if(!g.TryGetValue(item.Key+delta,out other))continue;var m=System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Match(other.name,@"m(\d+)-t(\d+)-d(\d+)");int n=int.Parse(m.Groups[1].Value);if((mask&1)==0&&(n&1)==0){pairs++;if(t==int.Parse(m.Groups[2].Value))errors++;}if((mask&2)==0&&(n&2)==0){pairs++;if(d==int.Parse(m.Groups[3].Value))errors++;}}}lines.Add(s.name+" top="+top+" down="+down+" distinctTop="+usedTop.Count+" distinctDown="+usedDown.Count+" checkedAdjacentPairs="+pairs);}lines.Add("ERRORS="+errors);if(errors!=0)throw new System.Exception("Rock adjacency/stability validation failed="+errors);}finally{UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.RestoreSceneManagerSetup(setup);System.IO.File.WriteAllLines("scripts/rock-all-levels-20261111/adjacency.txt",lines);}
arguments.summary: Validate actual sprite adjacency and refresh stability across all eleven scenes
